cond_0001.intro: The Test Engineer's primary duty is to develop, implement, release and maintain test systems that ensure products perform their proposed functions in an acceptable manner. Developing and supporting internal test systems as well as supporting customer supplied test systems (ICT – In-Circuit Test and FICT – Functional In-Circuit Test) are critical requirements for this role. This role is also responsible for using statistical methods to identify recurring problems and give detailed reports on defects.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Essential Functions: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Develops, supports, and implements ICT and FICT. Supports/implements customer supplied test systems. Using current industry standards, writes software to exercise units under functional test or in-circuit test and programs firmware into IC's. Writes software to store and retrieve test results in a manufacturing execution system. Develops and Releases test instructions. Implements and manages revision and change control on tester hardware, software, test instructions, and other documentation associated with tester development. Validates tester hardware and software functions correctly before release to manufacturing. Performs ongoing quality assurance on tester hardware and software to ensure systems function as designed. Coordinates with the customer engineering group during quoting process on new prospective products. Uses precision test equipment to test and trouble shoot boards. Works with manufacturing engineering to release new products and resolve issues that might arise. Reads and interprets schematics and drawings. Provides training to others on test procedures. Prepares failure analysis reports for customers as required. Reports any major production errors that would affect product quality.
Competencies:
Organizational Skills
Thoroughness/Attention to detail
Results-oriented, strategic thinker and planner
Exceptional Communication Skills
Supervisory Responsibility: This position does not have supervisory responsibilities.
Work Environment: While performing the duties of this job, the employee can be exposed to moving parts and vibration. The noise level in the work environment can be medium.
Physical Demands: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. This position requires sitting several hours at a time, in addition to walking, bending, kneeling and climbing stairs throughout the day. The employee must lift and/or move items up to 25lbs and occasionally up to 50lbs with assistance.
Travel: Occasional travel during the day may be necessary.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS/BA in Engineering or AS/AA in Engineering Technology with 5+ years of relevant experience
Extensive test and troubleshooting experience
Proficient in the use of MS Office and computer hardware
Demonstrated experience in coding software utilizing Windows/other operating systems, SQL, Visual Basic, C, .Net, Labview or other software languages
Ability to use various test equipment to aid in troubleshooting
Preferred Requirements
BA/BS in Engineering or a related field
Electronic manufacturing experience
Familiarity with electrical CAD systems used to design and produce printed circuit boards
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0030.intro: The Test Engineer's primary duty is to develop, implement, release and maintain test systems that ensure products perform their proposed functions in an acceptable manner. Developing and supporting internal test systems as well as supporting customer supplied test systems (ICT – In-Circuit Test and FICT – Functional In-Circuit Test) are critical requirements for this role. This role is also responsible for using statistical methods to identify recurring problems and give detailed reports on defects.
cond_0030.responsibilities:
Essential Functions: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Develops, supports, and implements ICT and FICT. Supports/implements customer supplied test systems. Using current industry standards, writes software to exercise units under functional test or in-circuit test and programs firmware into IC's. Writes software to store and retrieve test results in a manufacturing execution system. Develops and Releases test instructions. Implements and manages revision and change control on tester hardware, software, test instructions, and other documentation associated with tester development. Validates tester hardware and software functions correctly before release to manufacturing. Performs ongoing quality assurance on tester hardware and software to ensure systems function as designed. Coordinates with the customer engineering group during quoting process on new prospective products. Uses precision test equipment to test and trouble shoot boards. Works with manufacturing engineering to release new products and resolve issues that might arise. Reads and interprets schematics and drawings. Provides training to others on test procedures. Prepares failure analysis reports for customers as required. Reports any major production errors that would affect product quality.

cond_0040.intro: The Test Engineer's primary duty is to develop, implement, release and maintain test systems that ensure products perform their proposed functions in an acceptable manner. Developing and supporting internal test systems as well as supporting customer supplied test systems (ICT – In-Circuit Test and FICT – Functional In-Circuit Test) are critical requirements for this role. This role is also responsible for using statistical methods to identify recurring problems and give detailed reports on defects. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of test systems and troubleshooting workflows.
cond_0040.responsibilities:
Essential Functions: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Develops, supports, and implements ICT and FICT. Supports/implements customer supplied test systems. Using current industry standards, writes software to exercise units under functional test or in-circuit test and programs firmware into IC's. Writes software to store and retrieve test results in a manufacturing execution system. Develops and Releases test instructions. Implements and manages revision and change control on tester hardware, software, test instructions, and other documentation associated with tester development. Validates tester hardware and software functions correctly before release to manufacturing. Performs ongoing quality assurance on tester hardware and software to ensure systems function as designed. Coordinates with the customer engineering group during quoting process on new prospective products. Uses precision test equipment to test and trouble shoot boards. Works with manufacturing engineering to release new products and resolve issues that might arise. Reads and interprets schematics and drawings. Provides training to others on test procedures. Prepares failure analysis reports for customers as required. Reports any major production errors that would affect product quality.
Competencies:
Organizational Skills
Thoroughness/Attention to detail
Results-oriented, strategic thinker and planner
Exceptional Communication Skills
Supervisory Responsibility: This position does not have supervisory responsibilities.
Work Environment: While performing the duties of this job, the employee can be exposed to moving parts and vibration. The noise level in the work environment can be medium.
Physical Demands: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. This position requires sitting several hours at a time, in addition to walking, bending, kneeling and climbing stairs throughout the day. The employee must lift and/or move items up to 25lbs and occasionally up to 50lbs with assistance.
Travel: Occasional travel during the day may be necessary.
cond_0040.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS/BA in Engineering or AS/AA in Engineering Technology with 5+ years of relevant experience
Extensive test and troubleshooting experience
Proficient in the use of MS Office and computer hardware
Demonstrated experience in coding software utilizing Windows/other operating systems, SQL, Visual Basic, C, .Net, Labview or other software languages
Ability to use various test equipment to aid in troubleshooting
Preferred Requirements
BA/BS in Engineering or a related field
Electronic manufacturing experience
Familiarity with electrical CAD systems used to design and produce printed circuit boards

Developing and supporting internal test systems as well as supporting customer supplied test systems (ICT – In-Circuit Test and FICT – Functional In-Circuit Test) are critical requirements for this role. This role is also responsible for using statistical methods to identify recurring problems and give detailed reports on defects. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of test systems and troubleshooting work.
cond_0049.responsibilities:
Develops, supports, and implements ICT and FICT. Supports/implements customer supplied test systems. Using current industry standards, writes software to exercise units under functional test or in-circuit test and programs firmware into IC's. Writes software to store and retrieve test results in a manufacturing execution system. Develops and Releases test instructions. Implements and manages revision and change control on tester hardware, software, test instructions, and other documentation associated with tester development. Validates tester hardware and software functions correctly before release to manufacturing. Performs ongoing quality assurance on tester hardware and software to ensure systems function as designed. Coordinates with the customer engineering group during quoting process on new prospective products. Uses precision test equipment to test and trouble shoot boards. Works with manufacturing engineering to release new products and resolve issues that might arise. Reads and interprets schematics and drawings. Provides training to others on test procedures. Prepares failure analysis reports for customers as required. Reports any major production errors that would affect product quality.

Developing and supporting internal test systems as well as supporting customer supplied test systems (ICT – In-Circuit Test and FICT – Functional In-Circuit Test) are critical requirements for this role. This role also involves using statistical methods to identify recurring problems and provide detailed reports on defects.
cond_0090.responsibilities:
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Coordinates with the team to develop, support, and implement ICT and FICT. Supports and implements customer supplied test systems. Using current industry standards, writes software in coordination with engineering to exercise units under functional test or in-circuit test and programs firmware into ICs. Writes software to store and retrieve test results in a manufacturing execution system. Collaborates on developing and releasing test instructions. Works with the team to implement and manage revision and change control on tester hardware, software, test instructions, and other documentation associated with tester development. Validates tester hardware and software functions correctly before release to manufacturing. Performs ongoing quality assurance on tester hardware and software to help ensure systems function as designed. Coordinates with the customer engineering group during the quoting process on new prospective products. Uses precision test equipment to test and troubleshoot boards. Works alongside manufacturing engineering to release new products and resolve issues that might arise. Reads and interprets schematics and drawings. Provides training to others on test procedures. Prepares failure analysis reports for customers as required. Reports any major production errors that would affect product quality.
cond_0090.requirements:
BS/BA in Engineering or AS/AA in Engineering Technology with 5+ years of relevant experience
Extensive test and troubleshooting experience
Proficient in the use of MS Office and computer hardware
Demonstrated experience in coding software utilizing Windows/other operating systems, SQL, Visual Basic, C, .Net, Labview or other software languages
Ability to use various test equipment to aid in troubleshooting
BA/BS in Engineering or a related field
Electronic manufacturing experience
Familiarity with electrical CAD systems used to design and produce printed circuit boards

This role is also responsible for using statistical methods to identify recurring problems and give detailed reports on defects.
cond_0101.responsibilities:
Essential Functions: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Develops, supports, and implements ICT and FICT. Supports/implements customer supplied test systems. Using current industry standards, writes software to exercise units under functional test or in-circuit test and programs firmware into IC's. Writes software to store and retrieve test results in a manufacturing execution system. Develops and Releases test instructions. Implements and manages revision and change control on tester hardware, software, test instructions, and other documentation associated with tester development. Validates tester hardware and software functions correctly before release to manufacturing. Performs ongoing quality assurance on tester hardware and software to ensure systems function as designed. Coordinates with the customer engineering group during quoting process on new prospective products. Uses precision test equipment to test and trouble shoot boards. Works with manufacturing engineering to release new products and resolve issues that might arise. Reads and interprets schematics and drawings. Provides training to others on test procedures. Prepares failure analysis reports for customers as required. Reports any major production errors that would affect product quality.
Competencies:
Organizational Skills
Thoroughness/Attention to detail
Results-oriented, strategic thinker and planner
Exceptional Communication Skills
Supervisory Responsibility: This position does not have supervisory responsibilities.
Work Environment: While performing the duties of this job, the employee can be exposed to moving parts and vibration. The noise level in the work environment can be medium.
Physical Demands: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. This position requires sitting several hours at a time, in addition to walking, bending, kneeling and climbing stairs throughout the day. The employee must lift and/or move items up to 25lbs and occasionally up to 50lbs with assistance.
Travel: Occasional travel during the day may be necessary.
cond_0101.requirements:
BS/BA in Engineering or AS/AA in Engineering Technology with 5+ years of demonstrated expertise in a relevant engineering discipline; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Extensive proven track record in test and troubleshooting, with deep knowledge of test methodologies and diagnostic techniques.
Strong command of MS Office and computer hardware.
Demonstrated expertise in coding software utilizing Windows/other operating systems, SQL, Visual Basic, C, .Net, Labview or other software languages.
Advanced proficiency with various test equipment to aid in troubleshooting.
BA/BS in Engineering or a related field required.
Substantial electronic manufacturing experience.
Solid understanding of electrical CAD systems used to design and produce printed circuit boards.
cond_0101.values: We value work that reflects care for people and consideration for its wider impact. We aim to make decisions in ways that are responsible, fair, and respectful.
cond_0101.workplace_support: We believe growth happens in supportive environments, not in isolation. Through mentorship, collaboration, and shared accountability, we create space for employees to learn, contribute, and succeed.

This role is also responsible for using statistical methods to identify recurring problems and give detailed reports on defects. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of test systems and troubleshooting workflows.
cond_0112.responsibilities:
Essential Functions: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Develops, supports, and implements ICT and FICT. Supports/implements customer supplied test systems. Using current industry standards, writes software to exercise units under functional test or in-circuit test and programs firmware into IC's. Writes software to store and retrieve test results in a manufacturing execution system. Develops and Releases test instructions. Implements and manages revision and change control on tester hardware, software, test instructions, and other documentation associated with tester development. Validates tester hardware and software functions correctly before release to manufacturing. Performs ongoing quality assurance on tester hardware and software to ensure systems function as designed. Coordinates with the customer engineering group during quoting process on new prospective products. Uses precision test equipment to test and trouble shoot boards. Works with manufacturing engineering to release new products and resolve issues that might arise. Reads and interprets schematics and drawings. Provides training to others on test procedures. Prepares failure analysis reports for customers as required. Reports any major production errors that would affect product quality.
Competencies:
Organizational Skills
Thoroughness/Attention to detail
Results-oriented, strategic thinker and planner
Exceptional Communication Skills
Supervisory Responsibility: This position does not have supervisory responsibilities.
Work Environment: While performing the duties of this job, the employee can be exposed to moving parts and vibration. The noise level in the work environment can be medium.
Physical Demands: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. This position requires sitting several hours at a time, in addition to walking, bending, kneeling and climbing stairs throughout the day. The employee must lift and/or move items up to 25lbs and occasionally up to 50lbs with assistance.
Travel: Occasional travel during the day may be necessary.
cond_0112.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS/BA in Engineering or AS/AA in Engineering Technology with 5+ years of relevant experience
Extensive test and troubleshooting experience
Proficient in the use of MS Office and computer hardware
Demonstrated experience in coding software utilizing Windows/other operating systems, SQL, Visual Basic, C, .Net, Labview or other software languages
Ability to use various test equipment to aid in troubleshooting
Preferred Requirements
BA/BS in Engineering or a related field
Electronic manufacturing experience
Familiarity with electrical CAD systems used to design and produce printed circuit boards
cond_0112.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0143.intro: The Test Engineer's primary duty is to develop, implement, release and maintain test systems that ensure products perform their proposed functions in an acceptable manner. Developing and supporting internal test systems as well as supporting customer supplied test systems (ICT – In-Circuit Test and FICT – Functional In-Circuit Test) are critical requirements for this role. This role is also responsible for using statistical methods to identify recurring problems and give detailed reports on defects.
cond_0143.responsibilities: Develops, supports, and implements ICT and FICT. Leads implementation of customer supplied test systems. Using current industry standards, writes software to exercise units under functional test or in-circuit test and programs firmware into IC's. Writes software to store and retrieve test results in a manufacturing execution system. Develops and releases test instructions. Implements and manages revision and change control on tester hardware, software, test instructions, and other documentation associated with tester development. Validates tester hardware and software functions correctly before release to manufacturing. Executes ongoing quality assurance on tester hardware and software to ensure systems function as designed. Leads coordination with the customer engineering group during quoting process on new prospective products. Uses precision test equipment to test and troubleshoot boards. Drives resolution of issues with manufacturing engineering when releasing new products. Reads and interprets schematics and drawings. Delivers training to others on test procedures. Prepares failure analysis reports for customers as required. Reports any major production errors that would affect product quality.
cond_0143.requirements:
BS/BA in Engineering or AS/AA in Engineering Technology with 5+ years of relevant experience
Extensive test and troubleshooting experience
Proficient in the use of MS Office and computer hardware
Demonstrated experience in coding software utilizing Windows/other operating systems, SQL, Visual Basic, C, .Net, Labview or other software languages
Ability to use various test equipment to aid in troubleshooting
BA/BS in Engineering or a related field
Electronic manufacturing experience
Familiarity with electrical CAD systems used to design and produce printed circuit boards

cond_0153.intro: The Test Engineer's primary duty is to develop, implement, release and maintain test systems that ensure products perform their proposed functions in an acceptable manner. Developing and supporting internal test systems as well as supporting customer supplied test systems (ICT – In-Circuit Test and FICT – Functional In-Circuit Test) are critical requirements for this role. This role also works with statistical methods to identify recurring problems and give detailed reports on defects.
cond_0153.responsibilities:
Essential Functions: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Coordinates with the team to develop, support, and implement ICT and FICT. Supports and helps implement customer supplied test systems. Using current industry standards, collaborates on writing software to exercise units under functional test or in-circuit test and programs firmware into IC's. Works with the team to write software to store and retrieve test results in a manufacturing execution system. Develops and releases test instructions. Shares responsibility for revision and change control on tester hardware, software, test instructions, and other documentation associated with tester development. Validates tester hardware and software functions correctly before release to manufacturing. Performs ongoing quality assurance on tester hardware and software to ensure systems function as designed. Coordinates with the customer engineering group during quoting process on new prospective products. Uses precision test equipment to test and troubleshoot boards. Works with manufacturing engineering to release new products and resolve issues that might arise. Reads and interprets schematics and drawings. Provides training to others on test procedures. Prepares failure analysis reports for customers as required. Reports any major production errors that would affect product quality.
cond_0153.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS/BA in Engineering or AS/AA in Engineering Technology with 5+ years of relevant experience
Extensive test and troubleshooting experience
Proficient in the use of MS Office and computer hardware
Demonstrated experience in coding software utilizing Windows/other operating systems, SQL, Visual Basic, C, .Net, Labview or other software languages
Ability to use various test equipment to aid in troubleshooting
Preferred Requirements
BA/BS in Engineering or a related field
Electronic manufacturing experience
Familiarity with electrical CAD systems used to design and produce printed circuit boards

Developing and supporting internal test systems as well as supporting customer supplied test systems (ICT – In-Circuit Test and FICT – Functional In-Circuit Test) are critical requirements for this role. This role is also responsible for using statistical methods to identify recurring problems and give detailed reports on defects. Most people become stronger in this work over time as they build experience with test systems and troubleshooting.
cond_0248.responsibilities:
Essential Functions: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Develops, supports, and implements ICT and FICT. Supports/implements customer supplied test systems. Using current industry standards, writes software to exercise units under functional test or in-circuit test and programs firmware into IC's. Writes software to store and retrieve test results in a manufacturing execution system. Develops and Releases test instructions. Implements and manages revision and change control on tester hardware, software, test instructions, and other documentation associated with tester development. Validates tester hardware and software functions correctly before release to manufacturing. Performs ongoing quality assurance on tester hardware and software to ensure systems function as designed. Coordinates with the customer engineering group during quoting process on new prospective products. Uses precision test equipment to test and trouble shoot boards. Works with manufacturing engineering to release new products and resolve issues that might arise. Reads and interprets schematics and drawings. Provides training to others on test procedures. Prepares failure analysis reports for customers as required. Reports any major production errors that would affect product quality.

Organizational Skills
Thoroughness/Attention to detail
Results-oriented, strategic thinker and planner
Exceptional Communication Skills

cond_0258.intro: The Test Engineer's primary duty is to develop, implement, release and maintain test systems that ensure products perform their proposed functions in an acceptable manner. Developing and supporting internal test systems as well as regularly communicating with customer teams on customer supplied test systems (ICT – In-Circuit Test and FICT – Functional In-Circuit Test) are critical requirements for this role. This role is also responsible for using statistical methods to identify recurring problems and give detailed reports on defects.
cond_0258.responsibilities: Develops, supports, and implements ICT and FICT. Supports/implements customer supplied test systems. Using current industry standards, writes software to exercise units under functional test or in-circuit test and programs firmware into IC's. Writes software to store and retrieve test results in a manufacturing execution system. Develops and releases test instructions. Implements and manages revision and change control on tester hardware, software, test instructions, and other documentation associated with tester development. Validates tester hardware and software functions correctly before release to manufacturing. Performs ongoing quality assurance on tester hardware and software to ensure systems function as designed. Actively coordinates with the customer engineering group during the quoting process on new prospective products, clarifying requirements and walking them through technical details as needed. Uses precision test equipment to test and troubleshoot boards. Works closely with manufacturing engineering to release new products and resolve issues that might arise. Reads and interprets schematics and drawings. Provides training to others on test procedures. Prepares failure analysis reports for customers as required. Reports any major production errors that would affect product quality.
cond_0258.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS/BA in Engineering or AS/AA in Engineering Technology with 5+ years of relevant experience
Extensive test and troubleshooting experience
Demonstrated experience in coding software utilizing Windows/other operating systems, SQL, Visual Basic, C, .Net, Labview or other software languages
Ability to use various test equipment to aid in troubleshooting
Strong communication skills, with comfort explaining technical issues and interacting regularly with engineering and manufacturing teams
Preferred Requirements
Proficient in the use of MS Office and computer hardware
Electronic manufacturing experience
Familiarity with electrical CAD systems used to design and produce printed circuit boards

This role is also responsible for using statistical methods to identify recurring problems and give detailed reports on defects.
cond_0267.responsibilities: Develops, supports, and implements ICT and FICT. Supports/implements customer-supplied test systems. Using current industry standards, writes software to exercise units under functional test or in-circuit test and programs firmware into ICs. Writes software to store and retrieve test results in a manufacturing execution system. Develops and releases test instructions. Implements and manages revision and change control on tester hardware, software, test instructions, and other documentation associated with tester development. Validates tester hardware and software functions correctly before release to manufacturing. Performs ongoing quality assurance on tester hardware and software to ensure systems function as designed. Actively coordinates with the customer engineering group during the quoting process on new prospective products, clarifying requirements and walking them through technical decisions as needed. Uses precision test equipment to test and troubleshoot boards. Works closely with manufacturing engineering to release new products and resolve issues that arise, regularly communicating progress and findings. Reads and interprets schematics and drawings. Provides hands-on training to others on test procedures. Prepares failure analysis reports for customers as required. Reports any major production errors that would affect product quality.
cond_0267.requirements:
BS/BA in Engineering or AS/AA in Engineering Technology with 5+ years of relevant experience
Extensive test and troubleshooting experience
Proficient in the use of MS Office and computer hardware
Demonstrated experience in coding software utilizing Windows/other operating systems, SQL, Visual Basic, C, .Net, Labview or other software languages
Ability to use various test equipment to aid in troubleshooting
Electronic manufacturing experience
Familiarity with electrical CAD systems used to design and produce printed circuit boards
Organizational skills
Thoroughness and attention to detail
Results-oriented, strategic thinker and planner
Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues clearly to others
cond_0267.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0267.values: We value excellence, focus, and the ability to produce strong outcomes. We believe organizations succeed when they hold themselves to a high bar.

cond_0351.intro: The Test Engineer's primary duty is to develop, implement, release and maintain test systems that ensure products perform their proposed functions in an acceptable manner. Developing and supporting internal test systems as well as supporting customer supplied test systems (ICT – In-Circuit Test and FICT – Functional In-Circuit Test) are critical requirements for this role. This role also works with statistical methods to identify recurring problems and give detailed reports on defects.
cond_0351.responsibilities:
Essential Functions: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Coordinates with the team to develop, support, and implement ICT and FICT. Supports and helps implement customer supplied test systems. Using current industry standards, collaborates on writing software to exercise units under functional test or in-circuit test and programs firmware into IC's. Works with the team to write software to store and retrieve test results in a manufacturing execution system. Develops and releases test instructions. Shares responsibility for revision and change control on tester hardware, software, test instructions, and other documentation associated with tester development. Validates tester hardware and software functions correctly before release to manufacturing. Performs ongoing quality assurance on tester hardware and software to ensure systems function as designed. Coordinates with the customer engineering group during quoting process on new prospective products. Uses precision test equipment to test and troubleshoot boards. Works with manufacturing engineering to release new products and resolve issues that might arise. Reads and interprets schematics and drawings. Provides training to others on test procedures. Prepares failure analysis reports for customers as required. Reports any major production errors that would affect product quality.
cond_0351.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS/BA in Engineering or AS/AA in Engineering Technology with 5+ years of relevant experience
Extensive test and troubleshooting experience
Proficient in the use of MS Office and computer hardware
Demonstrated experience in coding software utilizing Windows/other operating systems, SQL, Visual Basic, C, .Net, Labview or other software languages
Ability to use various test equipment to aid in troubleshooting
Preferred Requirements
BA/BS in Engineering or a related field
Electronic manufacturing experience
Familiarity with electrical CAD systems used to design and produce printed circuit boards

This role is also responsible for using statistical methods to identify recurring problems and give detailed reports on defects.
cond_0469.responsibilities:
Essential Functions: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Develops, supports, and implements ICT and FICT. Supports/implements customer supplied test systems. Using current industry standards, writes software to exercise units under functional test or in-circuit test and programs firmware into IC's. Writes software to store and retrieve test results in a manufacturing execution system. Develops and Releases test instructions. Implements and manages revision and change control on tester hardware, software, test instructions, and other documentation associated with tester development. Validates tester hardware and software functions correctly before release to manufacturing. Performs ongoing quality assurance on tester hardware and software to ensure systems function as designed. Coordinates with the customer engineering group during quoting process on new prospective products. Uses precision test equipment to test and trouble shoot boards. Works with manufacturing engineering to release new products and resolve issues that might arise. Reads and interprets schematics and drawings. Provides training to others on test procedures. Prepares failure analysis reports for customers as required. Reports any major production errors that would affect product quality.
Competencies:
Organizational Skills
Thoroughness/Attention to detail
Results-oriented, strategic thinker and planner
Exceptional Communication Skills
Supervisory Responsibility: This position does not have supervisory responsibilities.
Work Environment: While performing the duties of this job, the employee can be exposed to moving parts and vibration. The noise level in the work environment can be medium.
Physical Demands: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. This position requires sitting several hours at a time, in addition to walking, bending, kneeling and climbing stairs throughout the day. The employee must lift and/or move items up to 25lbs and occasionally up to 50lbs with assistance.
Travel: Occasional travel during the day may be necessary.
cond_0469.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS/BA in Engineering or AS/AA in Engineering Technology with 5+ years of relevant experience
Extensive test and troubleshooting experience
Proficient in the use of MS Office and computer hardware
Demonstrated experience in coding software utilizing Windows/other operating systems, SQL, Visual Basic, C, .Net, Labview or other software languages
Ability to use various test equipment to aid in troubleshooting
Preferred Requirements
BA/BS in Engineering or a related field
Electronic manufacturing experience
Familiarity with electrical CAD systems used to design and produce printed circuit boards

This role is also responsible for using statistical methods to identify recurring problems and give detailed reports on defects.
cond_0521.responsibilities: Develops, supports, and implements ICT and FICT. Leads implementation of customer supplied test systems. Using current industry standards, writes software to exercise units under functional test or in-circuit test and programs firmware into IC's. Writes software to store and retrieve test results in a manufacturing execution system. Develops and releases test instructions. Implements and manages revision and change control on tester hardware, software, test instructions, and other documentation associated with tester development. Validates tester hardware and software functions correctly before release to manufacturing. Executes ongoing quality assurance on tester hardware and software to ensure systems function as designed. Leads coordination with the customer engineering group during quoting process on new prospective products. Uses precision test equipment to test and troubleshoot boards. Drives resolution of issues with manufacturing engineering when releasing new products. Reads and interprets schematics and drawings. Delivers training to others on test procedures. Prepares failure analysis reports for customers as required. Reports any major production errors that would affect product quality.
cond_0521.requirements:
BS/BA in Engineering or AS/AA in Engineering Technology with 5+ years of relevant experience
Extensive test and troubleshooting experience
Proficient in the use of MS Office and computer hardware
Demonstrated experience in coding software utilizing Windows/other operating systems, SQL, Visual Basic, C, .Net, Labview or other software languages
Ability to use various test equipment to aid in troubleshooting
BA/BS in Engineering or a related field
Electronic manufacturing experience
Familiarity with electrical CAD systems used to design and produce printed circuit boards
cond_0521.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0521.workplace_support: We believe growth happens in supportive environments, not in isolation. Through mentorship, collaboration, and shared accountability, we create space for employees to learn, contribute, and succeed.
